cloud.title: uRADMonitor account
cloud.description: Use the API Credentials on your uRADMonitor profile (uradmonitor.com/wp-admin/profile.php). Every unit you own, or were given access to, is added.

local.title: Local units
local.description: Add the address of each unit on your network to read its /j page directly, e.g. 192.168.1.50 or 192.168.1.50:8080. Local readings are used while the unit answers; the cloud fills in AQI and anything else. Give each unit a fixed IP (a DHCP reservation on your router).

data_description.locals: Optional with the cloud. Leave empty to read only the cloud.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to uRADMonitor again
reauth_confirm.description: uRADMonitor rejected the saved API Credentials. Copy the API user-id and API key again from your profile (uradmonitor.com/wp-admin/profile.php).

error.invalid_auth: uRADMonitor rejected the User ID or User Key. Copy the API user-id and API key again from your profile's API Credentials.
error.no_local: Add at least one unit address, or pick a source with the cloud.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This uRADMonitor account or unit address is already set up.

data_description.cloud_interval: At least 120 seconds. Units upload about once a minute; please keep the load on uRADMonitor's free API light.
